title: RTP Component MAX
raw_text:

o Set (green traffic light) Input parameter 1 — Quantity consumption profile
o Set (green traffic light) Output parameter 1 — Copy of consumption profile

o Not set (red traffic light) Output parameter 2 — Copy as demand profile

RTP Component MAX

e RTP Component Code Default
o Set (green traffic light) Input parameter 1 — Quantity consumption profile
o Not set (red traffic light) Output parameter 1 —- Copy of consumption profile

o Set (green traffic light) Output parameter 2 - Copy as demand profile

The ON/OFF component splits the load shape into on-peak and off-peak consumption. You define the component with reference to
an appropriate time-of-use group. The MAX component determines the maximum demand measured. In this case you do not have
to define the component with reference to a season group, day group, or time-of-use group. Therefore, you define the component

without reference to a season group, day group, or time-of-use group.

In the ONOFF component, you allocate the role measured consumption to the input parameter for the entire period. This
corresponds to the load shape of the interval meter in the billing period. You allocate the first output parameter result parameter
001 for the on-peak period and O02 for the off-peak period.

In the MAX component you also allocate the role measured consumption to the input parameter because the load shape also

provides the basis for determining maximum demand. You allocate result parameter O03 to the second output parameter in the
component for the whole period.

You can then use the RTP interface to define an appropriate rate.

For example, you can create a rate HTNTMAX that is permitted for interval meters, to which you allocate the HTNTMAX RTP
interface.

You create rate steps that valuate the on- and off-peak consumption as well as the maximum demand measured.

No.                  Variant            Input O1           Input 02          Output 01
001         QUANTIO1    ONCONSM | ONPRICE     ONAMNT
002                QUANTIO1       OFFCONSM | OFFPRICE        OFFAMNT
003                 DEMANDO1 | MAXDEMND  DEMNDPRC | DEMNDAM

You define the operands ONCONSM, OFFCONSM und DEMNDPRC as RTP operands. In the rate facts, you allocate result parameter
001 to the operand ONCONSM, result parameter 002 to the operand OFFCONSM, and result parameter 003 to the operand
MAXDEMND.
